net_rr_algebraic_proof.formula: net_rr = (target_distance - (entry*taker_fee + tp*taker_fee + entry_slippage)) / (stop_distance + (entry*taker_fee + sl*taker_fee + entry_slippage + sl_slippage))
net_rr_algebraic_proof.target_selection_mechanism: resolve_executable_target -> select_unconsumed_target selects the NEAREST unconsumed M1 (left=2,right=2) or M5 (left=1,right=1) swing beyond max(1.0*atr_m1, 0.50). When nearest M1 swing is $1.50-$3.42 away, round-trip taker fee + slippage ($3.41/oz) exceeds gross target distance, yielding negative net_reward and net_rr < 0.
net_rr_algebraic_proof.when_eligible_occurs_naturally: Across all 22,346 M1 bars, 106 canonical decisions (at 32 unique M1 timestamps) naturally achieve net_rr >= 2.0 (up to net_rr = 4.3322) when price breaks beyond recent M1 swings so the nearest unconsumed pool in the 120-bar M1 / 96-bar M5 window is a distant M5 swing $26.00-$33.50 away.
